purpose: Science-only axes for the eventual Pareto analysis (engineering burden axes are Integration Owner's responsibility, supplied separately). Multi-objective reasoning is preserved deliberately - no single collapsed score is computed here.
explicit_non_goal: This artifact does NOT compute TOTAL_SCORE = SCIENCE + MASS + POWER or any other arbitrary-weighted composite. It defines the science-side axes so the eventual Pareto process can compare configurations without hiding tradeoffs.

incremental_value.definition: Does the modality measurably improve a target beyond an appropriate (capacity-matched where applicable) baseline?
incremental_value.scale: POSITIVE / NEUTRAL / MIXED / NEGATIVE (from confidence_dimensions.D_aggregate_effect in results/stage4_architecture_science_decision_framework.json)

breadth.definition: How many meaningful, distinct physiological targets does the modality support across the current governing evidence set?
breadth.scale: count of distinct target/endpoint entries in results/stage4_science_consumption_manifest.json referencing this modality

evidence_maturity.definition: Internal / external / bounded / pending, per the confidence tier system.

robustness.definition: Consistency across subjects, seeds, datasets, and conditions.
robustness.scale: qualitative, drawn from each family's heterogeneity/sensitivity fields in results/stage4_science_consumption_manifest.json

uniqueness.definition: Does another already-present modality capture materially the same information?
uniqueness.scale: qualitative judgment per modality pair, see shared_resource_analysis below

dependency.definition: Does the sensor's utility depend strongly on another sensor being present (e.g. IMU's value is defined relative to PPG-only)?

decision_fragility.definition: Could one subject, one dataset, or one control choice reversal alter the conclusion?

mission_relevance.definition: How important is the supported physiological endpoint to the project's stated scope (autonomic/cardiovascular/cognitive/fluid-shift monitoring during spaceflight-analog conditions)?
mission_relevance.scale: qualitative, explicit per modality; distinguishes terrestrial-analog relevance from established spaceflight relevance per the H_external_validity dimension

per_modality_axis_values.breadth: 1 (HR estimation) - IMU's tested value is specific to HR estimation, not broader activity/motion targets in this evidence set
per_modality_axis_values.robustness: HIGH within tested datasets (5/5 and 12/18-13/18 favorable directions); real but modest heterogeneity disclosed
per_modality_axis_values.uniqueness: IMU is the only tested source of temporal-correspondence/motion-artifact-context information in this evidence set - not redundant with PPG alone
per_modality_axis_values.dependency: IMU's tested value is defined relative to a PPG-only baseline (A_cap); it has no independently-tested value without PPG in this evidence set
per_modality_axis_values.mission_relevance: HR estimation is a core autonomic/cardiovascular monitoring target for the project's stated scope

per_modality_axis_values.robustness: Consistent same-dataset (4/5 seeds, two independent comparisons); external evidence underpowered (n=7, 1 test recording)
per_modality_axis_values.uniqueness: EOG captures eye-movement information not present in EEG alone - the primary basis for its own testing as an addition
per_modality_axis_values.dependency: Tested only as an addition to EEG; no independently-tested standalone value in this evidence set
per_modality_axis_values.mission_relevance: Sleep-stage monitoring is a stated cognitive/circadian target for the project's scope

per_modality_axis_values.breadth: 1 (LBNP-stage/central hypovolemic stress estimation) - the only tested target
per_modality_axis_values.robustness: LOW - both key comparisons substantially subject-9-influenced
per_modality_axis_values.uniqueness: Would be the only tested source of thoracic-impedance information; ECG+pleth alone does not capture this signal type
per_modality_axis_values.dependency: Tested only as an addition to ECG+pleth; no standalone value tested
per_modality_axis_values.mission_relevance: Central hypovolemic stress / fluid-shift-adjacent monitoring is a stated project target, but current evidence does not support this specific modality/target pairing

per_modality_axis_values.breadth: 1 (baseline-relative body-mass-change proxy) - the only tested target
per_modality_axis_values.uniqueness: Would add lower-body fluid/tissue information not captured by arms+trunk BioZ alone
per_modality_axis_values.dependency: Tested only as an addition to arms+trunk BioZ; no standalone value tested
per_modality_axis_values.mission_relevance: Body-mass/fluid-shift monitoring is a stated project target; current evidence for THIS specific extension (legs beyond arms+trunk) is inconclusive

per_modality_axis_values.robustness: LOW - n=4 test subjects, fragile per-seed deltas
per_modality_axis_values.uniqueness: A second PPG site would in principle add pulse-transit-time information not available from a single site, but the tested implementation did not realize this benefit
per_modality_axis_values.dependency: Tested only as an addition to a primary PPG site; no standalone value tested
per_modality_axis_values.decision_fragility: LOW (consistently negative; not a single-subject artifact per prior sprints)
per_modality_axis_values.mission_relevance: PTT-based estimation (e.g. for BP-adjacent monitoring) is a stated project interest, but current evidence does not support this specific implementation
